title: Cubic Sample Expression Bound
statement: Let $n,M,A,E,Q$ be natural numbers and let $\varepsilon$ be a positive rational. If $M\le A(n+1)^E$ and $(1/\varepsilon)^2\le Q^2$, then $640M^3/\varepsilon^2\le 640A^3Q^2(n+1)^{3E}$.
